name: John W. Lawrence
bioAdditions: Son of Effingham Lawrence (b. 6 Jun 1760, a founder of the Tontine Coffee House, d. 13 Dec 1800), son of John, son of Richard, son of Joseph, son of William & Elizabeth Smith (S1): 5th cousin 6 times removed. Married Mary K., daughter of Mayor Walter Bowne.
